summary_1line: While the Pandavas live disguised in a Brahmana’s house, Kunti hears the host family lament a deadly dilemma threatening one of their lives.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kunti rushes into the Brahmana’s chamber to find the family seated together, weeping in despair over the fate awaiting one of them.
The sorrowful Brahmana sits with his wife, son, and daughter, lamenting the cruelty of life and the impossibility of choosing who must die.
